row.question: Which patients have statin adherence below 80% last year? Definition: Patients with 2 or more statin fills in the calendar year before as_of. PDC = days covered from the first fill in that year through 12-31, divided by those days; overlaps are not shifted; supply from earlier fills counts for days it covers. List patients with PDC below 80%.
